name: Popmotion
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: Functional animation primitives (animate, springs, inertia); superseded by Motion
summary: Small functional animation library: animate(), spring, decay, keyframes and easing utilities that emit values rather than touching the DOM. Driven from JavaScript; outputs numbers per frame. Its author folded it into Motion, which now carries the same primitives with active releases.
use_when: Reading legacy code that already uses Popmotion
avoid_when: Any new work: Motion is the maintained successor with the same primitives
Seekable springs: Motion or React Spring

assessment.rationale: Last release August 2022; Motion (catalogued) is the successor from the same author and covers the animate and spring primitives. No reason to add it.

notes: 2026-10-26: successor relationship asserted from the existing catalogue note, not re-read on popmotion.io.
